Named action watchers, dynamic grants, mana source name restrictions, selected sacrifice reductions and linked exile must retain their exact structured semantics.

mechanics.original_reminder: Cast this for {1}{R}{W}{B} to advance it as it enters. {1}{R}{W}{B}: Advance this as a sorcery.
mechanics.executable_reminder:
You may pay {Cost} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
As this permanent enters, if its advance cost was paid, have this permanent perform the advance action.
{Cost}: Have this permanent perform the advance action. Activate only as a sorcery.

rule_text.name: 702.264a
rule_text.rule: Advance is a keyword ability that represents a static ability that functions while the spell with advance is on the stack, and an activated ability. “Advance [cost]” means “You may choose to pay [cost] rather than pay this spell's mana cost. If you do, as the permanent it becomes enters the battlefield, it advances” and “[cost]: This permanent advances. Activate only as a sorcery.”

rule_text.name: 702.264b
rule_text.rule: “Advances” is a designation that has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that other spells and abilities can identify. The number of times a permanent has advanced is not part of the permanent's copiable values.

rule_text.name: 702.264c
rule_text.rule: If a triggered ability refers to the mana that was spent to advance a permanent, it means the mana used to cast that spell if that ability was triggered by the creature advancing as a result of being cast for its advance ability, the mana used to activate its advance ability if that ability was triggered by the creature advancing as a result of its advanced activated ability resolving, and nothing if it is triggered in some other manner.
